clue.text: Unobservant runners tailed off

parts.note: the nursery-rhyme trio who could not see, ran after the farmer's wife and had their tails cut off with a carving knife

explanation.surface: A description of athletes who weren't looking and dropped back in a race.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Runners' suggests athletes and 'tailed off' suggests fading in a race; really the runners are sightless creatures whose tails were literally cut off in the nursery rhyme.
explanation.definitionFit: The nursery-rhyme rodents are sightless, run after the farmer's wife and lose their tails.

clue.text: Arbiter in dispute? Cheese it!

indicators.note: a disputed matter is unsettled, so the letters of the word are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Someone tells a quarrelling referee to stop it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cheese it!' reads as slang for 'stop!', but 'Cheese' is the definition and 'it' a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Welsh rarebit is a dish of melted cheese on toast.

clue.text: Comes in a tea-chest individually

indicators.note: the answer is found sitting inside the hyphenated words that follow

explanation.surface: Items packed in a tea-chest arrive one at a time.
explanation.definitionFit: Each means apiece, one by one, as in 'a pound each'.

clue.text: Likeable retriever, currently cold

definitions.meaning: a popular, good-natured breed of gun dog
the cold ocean current flowing south off the Canadian coast bears this name

explanation.surface: A friendly gun dog is, at the moment, feeling chilly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'currently' looks like 'at present', but it points to an ocean current.
explanation.definitionFit: The dog breed and the chilly North Atlantic ocean current share the name of the Canadian peninsula.

clue.text: Brazil, Margaret? Or something more spicy

parts.note: a Brazil is a kind of nut
Meg is a short form of the name Margaret

explanation.surface: Choosing between a country and a woman's name, or something with more flavour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brazil' tempts as the country, but here it is the nut.
explanation.definitionFit: Nutmeg is a fragrant seed ground as a kitchen spice.

clue.text: Chick Romeo parodied in epic style

indicators.note: something parodied is mangled for comic effect, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A young lover is lampooned in grand poetic manner.
explanation.definitionFit: A mock-heroic work mimics the grand manner of epic poetry, usually for satire.

clue.text: Encouraging sound of a bird

parts.note: a cheerful chattering note such as a sparrow makes, also a clicking noise used to urge on a horse

explanation.surface: A cheerful call made by a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A chirrup is a short twittering call, used also as a coaxing click to animals.

clue.text: Fear of being partitioned, possibly

indicators.note: signals that the following word may be rearranged into another form

explanation.surface: Someone is anxious about having their country divided.
explanation.definitionFit: Trepidation is nervous dread or alarm.

clue.text: A reproof for the stonewaller, perhaps

definitions.text: A reproof for the stonewaller, perhaps

parts.words: A reproof for the stonewaller, perhaps
parts.note: a sharp criticism, pictured as a missile made from masonry, or the willow wielded by a defensive cricketer who stonewalls

explanation.surface: A rebuke aimed at a defensive batsman.
explanation.walkthrough: A stonewaller in cricket bats doggedly without scoring; a builder of walls deals in bricks.
explanation.definitionFit: A brickbat is a piece of hurled masonry and, figuratively, a harsh criticism.

clue.text: Maybe his announcements bring tears to his eyes

definitions.text: Maybe his announcements bring tears to his eyes

parts.words: Maybe his announcements bring tears to his eyes
parts.note: a town official who shouts public notices, jokingly imagined as one who weeps

explanation.surface: Someone so moved by his own news that he weeps.
explanation.walkthrough: A town official calls out notices; read literally, his title means someone who weeps.
explanation.definitionFit: A town official bellowing public notices is named after shouting, which also means weeping.

clue.text: Figure it isn't right when so called

definitions.text: Figure it isn't right when so called

parts.words: Figure it isn't right when so called
parts.note: a telephone digit sequence dialled in error, so the person reached is not the one intended

explanation.surface: Someone works out that a mistake has been made.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Figure' looks like the verb 'reckon', but it is a set of digits; 'called' means phoned.
explanation.definitionFit: Dialling incorrect digits connects you to a stranger rather than the intended person.

clue.text: Gem of a girl

explanation.surface: Praise for a delightful young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: The red precious stone also serves as a woman's first name.

clue.text: Accept blame in all innocence

parts.note: to bear punishment for something, typically for a wrong one did not commit

explanation.surface: Someone guiltless shoulders responsibility.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means suffering punishment, often undeservedly, on someone else's behalf.

clue.text: Smooth performance calling for a medal

definitions.meaning: a stroke is a smoothing caress, and play is a performance
the golf format counting total shots is also known as medal play

explanation.surface: A slick display that deserves a gold medal.
explanation.walkthrough: In golf, 'medal' competitions are scored by total strokes rather than holes won.
explanation.definitionFit: Golf scored by counting every shot is called medal play; stroking is smoothing.

clue.text: Symbolic system of 18 at the centre

indicators.note: the small word is placed in the middle of the cross-referenced answer

parts.note: refers to the answer to 18 across, a word for an idea

explanation.surface: A set of symbols is put right in the middle of entry 18.
explanation.walkthrough: 18 across gives NOTION; 'the centre' puts AT in its middle.
explanation.definitionFit: Notation is a set of written signs, as in musical or mathematical script.

clue.text: Plant a theologian held under cover

indicators.note: the plant's letters are gripped between the theologian's two letters

parts.note: DD stands for Doctor of Divinity, a theologian's degree
rape is a yellow-flowered plant grown for oilseed

explanation.surface: A churchman keeps a plant hidden away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plant' looks like a verb but is a noun, the oilseed crop RAPE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something draped is covered with cloth hanging in folds.

clue.text: Sea-lord's opposite number not above board?

definitions.text: Sea-lord's opposite number not above board?

parts.words: Sea-lord's opposite number not above board?
parts.note: the female counterpart of a lord on dry ground who provides board, that is meals, to lodgers

explanation.surface: An admiral's counterpart behaving dishonestly.
explanation.walkthrough: Swap sea for land and lord for lady; 'board' is lodging with meals, not honesty.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman letting rooms to lodgers, often with meals, mirrors the sea-lord on dry ground.

clue.text: Isn't one to get on, but has the idea

parts.note: not is the negative part of isn't
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone who doesn't fit in nonetheless understands.
explanation.definitionFit: A notion is a concept or belief held in the mind.

clue.text: Punishment for a civil wrong on the river

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits on top of the second

parts.note: a tort is a wrongful act giving rise to a civil lawsuit
the Ure is a river in Yorkshire

explanation.surface: A penalty for a misdemeanour committed by the water.
explanation.definitionFit: Torture is the infliction of severe pain as punishment or coercion.

clue.text: Plain to see from the freight list

definitions.meaning: a ship's or aircraft's document listing its cargo

explanation.surface: Something is obvious from the cargo paperwork.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means obvious as an adjective and a cargo inventory as a noun.

clue.text: Listener at one time of the soil

parts.note: an ear is the organ that listens
then means formerly, at that time

explanation.surface: Someone who once listened is connected with the land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Listener' suggests a person, but it is the organ of hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: Earthen means made of clay or soil, like earthenware.

clue.text: A maths problem, and it leaves one breathless

indicators.note: a problem to be worked out suggests these letters must be rearranged

explanation.surface: An arithmetic puzzle leaves a pupil gasping.
explanation.definitionFit: Asthma is a respiratory condition causing shortness of breath.

clue.text: Everton or Liverpool? You can bank on it

definitions.meaning: both football clubs belong to the metropolitan county around the city
the land beside the river flowing past Liverpool is a riverbank

explanation.surface: A football fan is assured of their team.
explanation.walkthrough: Merseyside is the English county round Liverpool; 'bank' is a riverbank, not certainty.
explanation.definitionFit: The county containing both football clubs is literally the land at the side of the Mersey.

clue.text: Italian spirit

parts.note: an Italian word for verve borrowed into English, not a liqueur

explanation.surface: A drink from Italy, such as grappa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spirit' suggests a liquor, but it means liveliness.
explanation.definitionFit: Brio is vigour or vivacity, a loanword from Italian.

clue.text: Watering place, we take it

definitions.meaning: the English spa city famed for Roman ...
a wash in a tub is something one takes

explanation.surface: Someone assumes a place has water.
explanation.walkthrough: Bath is a spa town in Somerset, England; 'take it' also sounds like 'assume'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Somerset spa city and a wash in a tub share the name.

clue.text: No apparent difference in the quality

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the two words that follow

explanation.surface: Two products seem to have the same standard.
explanation.definitionFit: Equal means alike, identical in amount or value.

clue.text: It's worrying for one at the top

definitions.text: It's worrying for one at the top

parts.words: It's worrying for one at the top
parts.note: a pain in the cranium, also a trouble burdening a leader

explanation.surface: Stress weighs on a company boss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one at the top' reads as a chief, but also describes a pain in the skull.
explanation.definitionFit: A pain in the skull is also a figurative nuisance for any boss.

clue.text: Unlimited gratitude, say

parts.note: a heartfelt expression of profuse appreciation

explanation.surface: Someone expresses boundless appreciation.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a fulsome way of expressing thanks without limit.
